newsitem.title: UK: Orebi & Cie, Eraf, Nederland join to process cocoa.
newsitem.headline: Orebi & Cie, Eraf, Nederland join to process cocoa.

text.p: French cocoa product dealer Orebi & Cie, Ivorian shipper Eraf and Spanish cocoa processing and chocolate manufacturer Nederland S.A. said on Friday they will jointly open a processing factory in San Pedro in the Ivory Coast.

Building of the factory, which has a planned total capacity of 75,000 tons per annum to make cocoa butter and cake, is expected to start in April. The plant's first stage capacity of 25,000 tons is expected to start operating in early 1998, the partners said in a statement.

"We will be manufacturing products to meet the toughest European and North American standards and are confident that with this project, we will be able to add significantly to the service that we can give to our clients and to promote the 'Ivorian Label' on the international markets," said Orbei chairman Sylvain Orebi.
Cocoa & Chocolate Consultants Ltd, based in the UK, will manage the project.
